summary: MGSV: Joint Operations is an unofficial, fan-made multiplayer mod for Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain on PC. It brings the game's online functionality into the single-player world, so up to 16 players can share the open world and its missions.
One player is Venom Snake and hosts the session. Everyone else joins as a soldier chosen from the Mother Base roster. Players join and leave with in-game transitions rather than popping in and out.
The project is built in the open by Hound Protocol, a community development team. It is free, open to contributors, and does not include or distribute any game files.
